title: Ownership Claims
subtitle: Review claims submitted for your items or track claims you have made

actions.claim_button: I Think This Is Mine (Submit Claim)

dialog.approve_description: Approving confirms that the claimant has satisfied verification. You can then exchange handover details in Messages.
dialog.reject_description: Rejecting will dismiss this claim and allow other users to verify.

tracker.title: Your Ownership Claim
tracker.under_review_note: Submitted {{date}}. The finder is privately reviewing your answers.
tracker.on_hold_note: Another claimant is currently coordinating handover. If not completed, your claim will be reviewed.
tracker.rejected_neutral: We could not conclusively verify your claim on this item. Attempt {{current}} of 2.
tracker.cooldown_note: You may submit one final attempt after a 24-hour wait period.

handover.title: Safe Handover Coordination
handover.instructions: For safety, meet inside a busy public place or verified campus desk. Both parties must confirm handover to complete.

dispute.modal_desc: Opening a dispute will freeze the item status and alert platform administrators to review the case.
dispute.reason_placeholder: Describe what went wrong (e.g. Claimant did not show up, incorrect item, extortion demand)...

modal.title: Submit Ownership Verification
modal.submitted_desc: Your verification answers are encrypted and shared privately with the finder. You will receive a notification when reviewed.
modal.private_notice: Answer as specifically as possible. The finder keeps certain details hidden to verify the real owner.

questions.marks_label: Describe any distinguishing marks, scratches, stickers, or damage:
questions.marks_placeholder: e.g. Small scratch on the top-left corner, dinosaur sticker
questions.contents_label: What was inside, attached to, or stored with the item?
questions.contents_placeholder: e.g. Blue lanyard, transit pass, keychain charm
questions.date_place_label: When and where approximately did you lose it?
questions.date_place_placeholder: e.g. Tuesday around 4 PM near the Library 2nd floor
questions.category_detail_label: Category-specific detail (lock screen, serial, card bank):
questions.category_detail_placeholder: e.g. Lock screen shows mountain sunset; Bank name on debit card

proof.title: Attach Proof of Ownership (Optional)
proof.subtitle: Receipt, purchase invoice, box serial number, Find My Device screenshot, or photo of yourself with the item.
proof.privacy_warning: Important: Hide or blur unrelated personal information (such as credit card numbers, CVV, or other identity numbers) before uploading.
proof.upload_prompt: Click or drag proof file here

review.title: Summary & Additional Details
review.subtitle: Provide a comprehensive overview of your ownership details.
review.overall_proof_placeholder: Describe secret marks, stickers, wallpaper, contents inside, or purchase date in detail...
review.redaction_warning: This looks like a private number. We will hide it.

suspicious.prompt: Describe why this claim appears suspicious:
suspicious.success_toast: Claim reported as suspicious and flagged for moderation review.

dashboard.no_received: No claims currently pending review on your found items.
dashboard.no_submitted: You haven't submitted any ownership claims yet.

match.guidance_note: Guidance only; please review manually. Scoring evaluates detail overlap with hidden secrets and discounts public description mirroring.

form.max_file_size_error: Proof file size must be less than 5MB.
form.invalid_file_type: Please upload a valid JPG, PNG, WEBP, or PDF file.
